name: Base - Three Forks depot site
objective: Start/return point. Real Perseverance sample-depot location; the crewed habitat is hypothetical.
flags: Hypothetical habitat at a real depot location

Position = rover drive record sol 654 during Three Forks depot emplacement, first tube deposited sol 653 (NASA samples catalog; position from archived NASA M20 waypoints). The depot is an area, not a surveyed point.

name: Wildcat Ridge
objective: Fine-grained delta-front mudstones recording quiet-water deposition; the rover found organic signals correlated with sulfates here (not evidence of life).
photoNote: Mastcam-Z left 110mm frame, sol 502 (NASA raw image ZL0_0502_0711509044_013EBY_N0261222ZCAM07101_1100LMJ). NASA metadata confirms sol and camera; content attribution from the rover position that sol.
flags: Stop position = rover position during the Wildcat Ridge sampling campaign (samples Hazeltop sol 509, Bearwallow sol 516, per NASA samples catalog; position from archived NASA M20 waypoints drive record). The outcrop itself is not a surveyed point.

name: Skinner Ridge
objective: Layered sandstone with grains transported from far outside Jezero - sediment provenance and transport energy.
photoNote: Mastcam-Z left 110mm frame, sol 477 (NASA raw image ZL0_0477_0709275045_285EBY_N0260850ZCAM08498_1100LMJ). NASA metadata confirms sol and camera; content attribution from the rover position that sol.
flags: Stop position = rover position during the Skinner Ridge sampling campaign (samples Swift Run sol 490, Skyland sol 495, per NASA samples catalog; position from archived NASA M20 waypoints drive record). The outcrop itself is not a surveyed point.
Same outcrop complex as Wildcat (~20 m apart, from the two waypoint positions): two distinct objectives, not two distant outcrops

name: Kodiak candidate viewpoint
objective: Observe delta-layer geometry recording lake-level change and flooding (studied remotely by the rover).
photoNote: Mastcam-Z left 110mm frame, sol 275 (NASA raw image ZL0_0275_0691341248_678EBY_N0080000ZCAM08292_1100LMJ). NASA metadata confirms sol and camera; it does not identify the feature shown.
flags: Position unavailable: no numeric coordinate found in opened sources (NASA M20 waypoints, USGS SIM 3464, published studies describe Kodiak butte only relative to the landing site). Earlier approximate coordinate removed.
Studied remotely by the rover, never visited - excluded from route planning
